checks.sourceReview: All 125 recorded source/configuration/experiment fingerprints match after verification; git diff --check passed. Production assets contain none of the development fault-injection hooks.

timingScope: Single development runs with QA readback. First accepted completion is navigation-relative, not display scanout, production startup or a CPU/GPU speed comparison. Preparation callback measurements cover a subsequent 960x540 texture; exact-reference validation is outside that measurement interval. No moving-FPS or driver-settings claim.

research.scope: Four synthetic CPU cases, with independent reconstruction. Least-change real-valued bounds omit spectral and perceptual demands; not a candidate or acceptance. Prior gameplay tiny-step recording was not rerun.

independentReview: Reviewed preparation ownership, stale generations, retries, teardown and failure recovery; corrected same-key GPU upload invalidation and failed-preparation UI re-entry. Separate review checked contrast-constrained bounds, infeasible one-class cases and moment-preserving interpretation.
